mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies near Verona City Hall with a temperature of 55 degrees and a Waxing Gibbous moon overhead.
The city is hiring an Engineering Technician to oversee infrastructure projects through September 20, and residents can now apply for a 30 dollar rebate on new 35-gallon rain barrels.
Today, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, or head to the Verona Ice Arena for the Girls Try Hockey event. Tomorrow, look out for yoga at Insight Wellness.
On Friday, August 15, Verona police officers stopped a driver near North Main Street and Cross Country Road who was eventually arrested for a first offence O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Cashew. Culver's is currently closed, but they will open their doors at 10 AM. If you are looking for tomorrow's treat, it will be Dark Chocolate PB Crunch.
